ADMISSION_RULE.on_failure: scene not admitted -> overall verdict DESIGN_WITHOUT_POWER; no substitute object or window under this spec

CONTROL_WINDOW_RULE: [230,259] if it satisfies the admission criterion on every camera; otherwise the LATEST 30-frame window ending <= 299 and starting >= 130 that does
MECHANISM_FBOX_RULE: union of the cam00 evaluation silhouette over frames 63-87, padded 8 px, half-open [x0,y0,x1,y1) in render-raster pixels

anchor_semantics.B: LAST absent frame (object back on B+1)
anchor_semantics.CA: first frame of the control window
anchor_semantics.CB: last frame of the control window

arm_roles.G: construction-derived membership (rendered-contribution vote against the construction masks), authored gap
arm_roles.GESTMEM: S2 (SAM2) membership vote, T1 estimated gap; the fully estimated arm
arm_roles.GMIS: construction-derived membership, gap moved to the control window (timing sham)
arm_roles.GWRONGMEM_A: count-matched uniform draw over rows OUTSIDE the construction-derived set, zero overlap, seed 1000+prefix_seed
arm_roles.GWRONGMEM_L: local contribution-matched sham: rows outside the construction-derived set projecting inside the +20 px construction silhouette on >= 8 of 19 cameras at frames 50 and 95, greedy by contribution until total contribution mass at frame 50 on cam15 is within +-10% of the construction-derived set's
arm_roles.GONES: construction-derived membership, late gap [286,297] (code-path sham, not a null)

T1_PRECONDITION.on_failure: GEST and GESTMEM legs of that prefix DESIGN_WITHOUT_POWER

S2.click_rule: TWO positive clicks per training camera, one at frame 50 (seeds propagation 50->109) and one at frame 92 (seeds propagation 92->99), placed by the user from the RAW frames (click packet), coordinates recorded here BEFORE inference, no retries
S2.camera_drop_rule: applied at EACH seed frame separately: mask area at the seed frame < 500 px or > 5x the median over cameras -> camera dropped from the vote and listed; vote requires >= 12 remaining cameras

MEMBERSHIP_PRECONDITION.on_failure: prefix trains; its GESTMEM pair excluded from the mechanism-exercised set; counts toward Claim B DWP

CELL_PRECONDITION.fbox_frame_rule: frame 75 for arms gating [60,89]; the midpoint of the arm's own gap for GMIS and GONES
CELL_PRECONDITION.zero_presence_window: the arm's OWN gap interior (edges excluded), for every gated arm including GMIS and GONES
CELL_PRECONDITION.on_failure: reported, in ITT tables, excluded from the mechanism-exercised set

EVALUATOR.note: the only evaluator for wave-2 scoring; main.py --val is not used

CLAIM_A.name: membership- and window-specific benefit with construction-derived membership

C1.note: predeclared accepted cost; no general no-harm claim while C1 > 0

CLAIM_B.name: the fully estimated gate (S2 membership, T1 gap)
CLAIM_B.admission: all 4 prefixes pass MEMBERSHIP_PRECONDITION and T1_PRECONDITION
CLAIM_B.harm_guards_every_pair: as CLAIM_A with GESTMEM in place of G
CLAIM_B.on_fewer_admitted: DESIGN_WITHOUT_POWER, reported as 'membership instrument not admitted'

VERDICT_RULE: per claim: any required-scene non-admission, incomplete pair set, or precondition failure leaving < 4 pairs -> DESIGN_WITHOUT_POWER; else both confirmatory scenes MET -> CLAIM_CONDITIONS_MET; else one MET -> PARTIAL (reported, not claimed); else NOT_MET. The calibration scene receives the same per-scene reading labelled CALIBRATION.
PAIRED_VERDICT_STATUS: DESCRIPTIVE at n = 4 pairs per scene: median, range, sign consistency, paired-t interval labelled descriptive; no p-value, no equivalence claim; sizing informational

WORDING.fixture_absence: exact-zero presence (zero-error frames are a reported count, never a fixture claim)
WORDING.sham_sentence: G provides at least 0.5 dB incremental benefit over each sham

OUT_OF_SCOPE: physical absence discovery in unedited footage
competitiveness against external methods (X is descriptive)

EXTERNAL_BASELINE.status: pending admission; NOT RUN with reason if not admitted
